snapshot_policy: Snapshots are local research cache, excluded from distribution. URLs, acquisition times and SHA256 are published here. Mutable upstream URLs may not reproduce the same bytes later. Missing snapshots must be reacquired and identity differences recorded, never silently treated as the same evidence.
